newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market steady at $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market steady at $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand rather light. Feedlots current.

Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 88,800 head including 16,500 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1110 lbs 66.50-67.00.
